Skin/tissue changes.roman: Kan par funsiyan nikli hain.

Skin/tissue changes.en: The eruptions on or around the ear are filled with pus.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: कान पर मवाद भरे दाने निकले हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Kan par mawad bhare dane nikle hain.

Skin/tissue changes.en: There are scabs or crusts on or around the ear.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: कान पर पपड़ीदार दाने निकले हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Kan par papdi dar dane nikle hain.

Skin/tissue changes.en: The skin on or around the ear is covered in dry, flaky scales.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: कान पर पपड़ीदार-शल्की परतें (स्केली दाने) निकले हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Kan par papdi dar-shalki parten (scaly dane) nikle hain.

Skin/tissue changes.en: There are flaky, scurfy patches or crusts on the ear.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: कान पर रूसी जैसी खुरदरी परतें (स्कर्फ) हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Kan par russi jaisi khurduri parten (scarf) hain.

Skin/tissue changes.en: There are flaky, scurfy patches or crusts on the right ear.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: दाहिने कान पर रूसी जैसी खुरदरी परतें (स्कर्फ) हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Dahine kan par russi jaisi khurduri parten (scarf) hain.

Skin/tissue changes.en: There is a skin eruption on the small cartilage bump (tragus) at the front of the ear opening.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: कान के उभरे हुए छोटे हिस्से (ट्रेगस) पर दाने निकले हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Kan ke ubhre hue chhote hisse (tragus) par dane nikle hain.

Skin/tissue changes.en: There are flaky, scurfy crusts on the eardrum.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: कान के पर्दे (टिम्पेनम) पर रूसी जैसी खुरदरी परतें हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Kan ke parde (tympanum) par russi jaisi khurduri parten hain.

Skin/tissue changes.en: There are small fluid-filled blisters on the ear.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: कान पर पानी भरे छाले निकले हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Kan par pani bhare chale nikle hain.

Skin/tissue changes.en: There are small fluid-filled blisters on the ear that are merging together into larger ones.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: कान पर पानी भरे छाले निकले हैं जो आपस में मिल गए हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Kan par pani bhare chale nikle hain jo aapas mein mil gaye hain.

Skin/tissue changes.en: There are small blisters on the ear that are leaking watery fluid.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: कान पर पानी भरे छाले निकले हैं जिनसे पानी बह रहा है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Kan par pani bhare chale nikle hain jinse pani bah raha hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: There are small blisters on the ear that have turned gangrenous or severely infected.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: कान पर पानी भरे छाले निकले हैं जो सड़ने लगे हैं (गैंग्रीन जैसे)।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Kan par pani bhare chale nikle hain jo sadne lage hain (gangrene jaise).

Skin/tissue changes.en: There are small blisters on the ear that are filled with pus.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: कान पर पानी भरे छाले निकले हैं जिनमें मवाद भर गई है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Kaan par pani bhare chhale nikle hain jinmein mawad bhar gayi hai.

Skin/tissue changes.path: Ear, eruptions, vesicles, serum, filled with
Skin/tissue changes.en: There are small blisters on the ear filled with a clear, serum-like fluid.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: कान पर पानी भरे छाले निकले हैं जिनमें पीला पानी (सीरम) भरा है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Kaan par pani bhare chhale nikle hain jinmein pila pani (serum) bhara hai.

Skin/tissue changes.path: Ear, eruptions, vesicles, surrounded by inflamed base
Skin/tissue changes.en: There are small blisters on the ear that are surrounded by a red, inflamed base.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: कान पर पानी भरे छाले निकले हैं जिनके चारों तरफ की त्वचा लाल और सूजी हुई है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Kaan par pani bhare chhale nikle hain jinke charon taraf ki twacha lal aur suji hui hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: There are small transparent (see-through) blisters on the ear.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: कान पर पारदर्शी (साफ दिखने वाले) पानी भरे छाले निकले हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Kaan par pardarshi (saaf dikhne wale) pani bhare chhale nikle hain.

Skin/tissue changes.en: There are small white blisters on the ear.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: कान पर सफेद रंग के पानी भरे छाले निकले हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Kaan par safed rang ke pani bhare chhale nikle hain.

Skin/tissue changes.path: Ear, eruptions, vesicles, white, on red base
Skin/tissue changes.en: There are small white blisters on the ear sitting on a red base.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: कान पर सफेद रंग के पानी भरे छाले निकले हैं जो लाल त्वचा पर हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Kaan par safed rang ke pani bhare chhale nikle hain jo lal twacha par hain.

Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is a crawling, ant-like tingling sensation around the outside of the ear.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: कान के आसपास चींटियाँ चलने जैसी झनझनाहट होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Kaan ke aaspass chintiyaan chalne jaisi jhanjhanahat hoti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is a crawling, ant-like tingling sensation behind the ear.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: कान के पीछे चींटियाँ चलने जैसी झनझनाहट होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Kaan ke peeche chintiyaan chalne jaisi jhanjhanahat hoti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Ear, formication, extending to lower law
Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is a crawling, ant-like tingling sensation in the ear that spreads down to the lower jaw.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: कान में चींटियाँ चलने जैसी झनझनाहट होती है जो नीचे जबड़े तक फैलती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Kaan mein chintiyaan chalne jaisi jhanjhanahat hoti hai jo neeche jabde tak failti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is a crawling, ant-like tingling sensation inside the ear canal.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: कान की नली (छेद) में चींटियाँ चलने जैसी झनझनाहट होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Kaan ki nali (chhед) mein chintiyaan chalne jaisi jhanjhanahat hoti hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: There is a crawling, ant-like tingling sensation in or around the ear while eating.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: खाना खाते समय कान में चींटियाँ चलने जैसी झनझनाहट होती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Khana khate samay kaan mein chintiyaan chalne jaisi jhanjhanahat hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: There is a crawling, ant-like tingling sensation in or around the ear in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह के समय कान में चींटियाँ चलने जैसी झनझनाहट होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah ke samay kaan mein chintiyaan chalne jaisi jhanjhanahat hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: There is a sensation of fullness or blockage in the ear in the afternoon.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर के समय कान में भारीपन या बंद-बंद सा महसूस होता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar ke samay kan mein bhaari pan ya band-band sa mehsoos hota hai.

Linked to time of day.en: There is a sensation of fullness or blockage in the ear at 1 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर एक बजे कान में भारीपन या बंद-बंद सा महसूस होता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar ek baje kan mein bhaari pan ya band-band sa mehsoos hota hai.

Linked to time of day.en: There is a sensation of fullness or blockage in the ear in the evening.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम के समय कान में भारीपन महसूस होता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ke samay kan mein bhaari pan mehsoos hota hai.

Linked to time of day.en: There is a sensation of fullness or blockage in the ear in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह के समय कान में भारीपन महसूस होता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah ke samay kan mein bhaari pan mehsoos hota hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: There is a sensation of fullness or blockage in the ear when blowing the nose.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: नाक साफ करते (फूंकते) समय कान में भारीपन महसूस होता है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Nak saaf karte (phoonkte) samay kan mein bhaari pan mehsoos hota hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: The feeling of fullness in the ear gets better when pressing a finger into the ear canal.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: कान में उँगली या कोई चीज़ डालकर दबाने से कान का भारीपन कम हो जाता है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Kan mein ungli ya koi cheez daalkar dabane se kan ka bhaari pan kam ho jata hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: There is a sensation of fullness or blockage in the ear brought on by swallowing.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: निगलने पर कान में भारीपन महसूस होता है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Nigalne par kan mein bhaari pan mehsoos hota hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: There is a sensation of fullness or blockage in the ear while eating.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: खाना खाते समय कान में भारीपन महसूस होता है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Khana khate samay kan mein bhaari pan mehsoos hota hai.

Linked to mood/emotion.en: There is a sensation of fullness or blockage in the ear brought on by excitement or emotional upset.
Linked to mood/emotion.hi: उत्तेजना या घबराहट होने पर कान में भारीपन महसूस होता है।
Linked to mood/emotion.roman: Uttejna ya ghabrahat hone par kan mein bhaari pan mehsoos hota hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is a sensation of fullness or pressure in the ear.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: कान में भारीपन या बंद होने जैसा एहसास होता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Kan mein bhaari pan ya band hone jaisa ehsaas hota hai.

Comes with other symptoms.en: There is a sensation of fullness in the ear that comes on after a stitching pain.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: कान में चुभन होने के बाद भारीपन महसूस होता है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Kan mein chubhan hone ke baad bhaari pan mehsoos hota hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The ear feels hot in the afternoon.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर बाद कान गर्म लगता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar baad kan garm lagta hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The ear feels hot at 1 p.m. in the afternoon.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर एक बजे के आसपास कान गर्म लगता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar ek baje ke aaspas kan garm lagta hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The ear feels hot in the evening.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम के समय कान गर्म लगता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ke samay kaan garm lagta hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The ear feels hot at 10 p.m. in the evening.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात दस बजे के आसपास कान गर्म लगता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat das baje ke aaspas kaan garm lagta hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Ear, heat, evening, on going to bed
Linked to time of day.en: The ear feels hot in the evening when going to bed.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को बिस्तर पर जाते समय कान गर्म लगने लगता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko bistar par jate samay kaan garm lagne lagta hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Ear, heat, extending, to pharynx, evening while riding
Linked to time of day.en: There is heat in the ear that spreads to the throat in the evening while riding (in a vehicle).
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को सवारी करते समय कान की गर्मी गले के अंदर तक फैलती महसूस होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko savari karte samay kaan ki garmi gale ke andar tak phailti mehsus hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The ear feels hot in the morning while still in bed.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह बिस्तर में लेटे-लेटे कान गर्म लगता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah bistar mein lete-lete kaan garam lagta hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The ear feels hot at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात के समय कान गर्म लगता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ke samay kaan garam lagta hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The ear feels hot at midnight.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात के आधी रात को कान गर्म लगता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ke aadhi raat ko kaan garam lagta hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: The ear feels hot in the afternoon after drinking coffee.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: दोपहर बाद कॉफी पीने के बाद कान गर्म लगने लगता है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Dopahar baad coffee pine ke baad kan garm lagane lagta hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: The ear feels hot after eating.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: खाना खाने के बाद कान गर्म लगने लगता है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Khana khane ke baad kaan garm lagne lagta hai.

Comes with other symptoms.en: The ear feels hot during a chill or shivering episode.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: ठंड लगने (कँपकँपी) के साथ कान गर्म लगता है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Thandi lagane (kapkapi) ke saath kan garm lagta hai.

Comes with other symptoms.en: The ear feels hot during a chill or shivering episode.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: ठंड लगने (कँपकँपी) के दौरान कान गर्म लगता है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Thandi lagane (kapkapi) ke dauran kan garm lagta hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Ear, heat, chill, during, in back
Comes with other symptoms.en: The ear feels hot during a chill or shivering that is felt in the back.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: ठंड लगने के दौरान पीठ में ठंड महसूस होते समय कान गर्म लगता है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Thandi lagane ke dauran pith mein thandi mehsoos hote samay kan garm lagta hai.

Comes with other symptoms.en: The ear feels hot while the rest of the body feels cold.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: शरीर ठंडा रहने के बावजूद कान गर्म लगता है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Sharir thanda rehne ke baawjood kaan garm lagta hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Ear, heat, coldness of body, during
Comes with other symptoms.en: The ear feels hot while the rest of the body feels cold.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: शरीर ठंडा रहने के दौरान कान गर्म लगता है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Sharir thanda rehne ke dauran kaan garm lagta hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Ear, heat, pressure in occiput, during
Comes with other symptoms.en: The ear feels hot while there is a feeling of pressure at the back of the head.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: सिर के पिछले हिस्से में दबाव महसूस होते समय कान भी गर्म लगता है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Sir ke pichle hisse mein dabao mehsus hote samay kaan bhi garam lagta hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Ear, heat, redness of one ear, with
Comes with other symptoms.en: One ear is red and hot, along with redness of that same ear.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: एक कान लाल और गर्म होने के साथ-साथ यह तकलीफ होती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Ek kaan lal aur garam hone ke saath-saath yeh taklif hoti hai.

Temperature sensation.en: The ear alternates between feeling hot and feeling cold.
Temperature sensation.hi: कान में कभी गर्मी तो कभी ठंडक महसूस होती रहती है।
Temperature sensation.roman: Kan mein kabhi garmi to kabhi thandak mehsoos hoti rahti hai.

Temperature sensation.path: Ear, heat, coldness of body, during, to touch
Temperature sensation.en: The ear feels hot to the touch while the rest of the body feels cold.
Temperature sensation.hi: छूने पर शरीर ठंडा लगता है लेकिन कान गर्म महसूस होते हैं।
Temperature sensation.roman: Chhune par sharir thanda lagta hai lekin kaan garm mehsus hote hain.

Temperature sensation.en: There is a sensation of heat escaping from the ear.
Temperature sensation.hi: कान से गर्मी बाहर निकलती महसूस होती है।
Temperature sensation.roman: Kaan se garmi bahar nikti mehsus hoti hai.

Temperature sensation.en: There is a sensation of heat escaping from the ear.
Temperature sensation.hi: कान से गर्मी निकलने जैसा एहसास होता है।
Temperature sensation.roman: Kaan se garmi nikne jaisa ehsas hota hai.

Temperature sensation.en: There is heat in the ear that spreads to another area.
Temperature sensation.hi: कान की गर्मी किसी दूसरी जगह तक फैलती महसूस होती है।
Temperature sensation.roman: Kaan ki garmi kisi dusri jagah tak phailti mehsus hoti hai.

Temperature sensation.path: Ear, heat, extending over half of head
Temperature sensation.en: There is heat in the ear that spreads over half of the head.
Temperature sensation.hi: कान की गर्मी फैलकर आधे सिर तक पहुँच जाती है।
Temperature sensation.roman: Kaan ki garmi failkar adhe sir tak pahunch jati hai.

Temperature sensation.path: Ear, heat, extending, occiput to nape of neck
Temperature sensation.en: There is heat that spreads from the back of the head down to the back of the neck.
Temperature sensation.hi: कान की गर्मी सिर के पिछले हिस्से से गर्दन की पिछली तरफ तक फैलती है।
Temperature sensation.roman: Kaan ki garmi sir ke pichle hisse se gardan ki pichli taraf tak phailti hai.

Temperature sensation.en: The ear feels hot in sudden flushes of heat.
Temperature sensation.hi: कान में अचानक गर्मी की लहर उठती है।
Temperature sensation.roman: Kaan mein achanak garmi ki lahar uthti hai.

Temperature sensation.en: There is a feeling of heat deep inside the ear.
Temperature sensation.hi: कान के अंदर से गर्मी महसूस होती है।
Temperature sensation.roman: Kaan ke andar se garmi mehsus hoti hai.

Temperature sensation.en: The left ear feels hot.
Temperature sensation.hi: बायाँ कान गर्म लगता है।
Temperature sensation.roman: Bayan kaan garm lagta hai.

Temperature sensation.en: The left ear feels hot first, then the right ear becomes hot.
Temperature sensation.hi: पहले बायाँ कान गर्म लगता है, फिर दायाँ।
Temperature sensation.roman: Pehle bayan kaan garm lagta hai, phir dayan.

Temperature sensation.en: The ear canal feels hot.
Temperature sensation.hi: कान की नली (छेद) गर्म महसूस होती है।
Temperature sensation.roman: Kaan ki nali chhhed garm mehsus hoti hai.

Temperature sensation.en: One ear feels hot (but not both at the same time).
Temperature sensation.hi: एक तरफ का कान गर्म लगता है।
Temperature sensation.roman: Ek taraf ka kaan garam lagta hai.

Temperature sensation.en: One ear feels hot (but not both at the same time).
Temperature sensation.hi: सिर्फ एक तरफ का कान गर्म लगता है।
Temperature sensation.roman: Sirf ek taraf ka kaan garam lagta hai.

Temperature sensation.en: The right ear feels hot.
Temperature sensation.hi: दायाँ कान गर्म लगता है।
Temperature sensation.roman: Daya kaan garam lagta hai.

Temperature sensation.path: Ear, heat, right, red and hot, left pale and cold
Temperature sensation.en: The right ear is red and hot while the left ear is pale and cold.
Temperature sensation.hi: दायाँ कान लाल और गर्म है जबकि बायाँ कान पीला और ठंडा है।
Temperature sensation.roman: Daya kaan lal aur garam hai jabki baya kaan pila aur thanda hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Ear, heat, coldness of body, during, lying, while
Linked to posture/position.en: The ear feels hot while lying down, at the same time the rest of the body feels cold.
Linked to posture/position.hi: लेटे रहने पर जब शरीर ठंडा हो तो कान गर्म लगता है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Lete rehne par jab sharir thanda ho to kaan garm lagta hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Ear, heat, escaping, sensation of, as if hot water were running out of right
Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is a sensation as if hot water is running out of the right ear.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: दाएँ कान से गर्म पानी बाहर बह रहा हो जैसा एहसास होता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Dayen kaan se garm pani bahar bah raha ho jaisa ehsas hota hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: The ear feels hot when swallowing.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: निगलने पर कान में गर्मी महसूस होती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Nigalne par kaan mein garmi mehsus hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Ear, hollowness, in morning amel. after dinner
Linked to time of day.en: There is a hollow or empty feeling in the ear in the morning that gets better after the midday meal.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह कान खोखला लगता है जो खाना खाने के बाद ठीक हो जाता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah kaan khokla lagta hai jo khana khane ke baad theek ho jata hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is a sensation of hollowness or emptiness inside the ear.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: कान में खोखलापन या खालीपन जैसा एहसास होता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Kaan mein khoklpan ya kaalipen jaisa ehsas hota hai.

Inflammation.en: The outer bowl-shaped part of the ear (the concha) is inflamed.
Inflammation.hi: कान के बाहरी हिस्से (कटोरेनुमा भाग) में सूजन है।
Inflammation.roman: Kaan ke bahari hisse (katorenuuma bhag) mein sujan hai.

Inflammation.en: The ear has an erysipelas-type inflammation — red, hot, and spreading across the skin.
Inflammation.hi: कान में ऐसी सूजन है जो त्वचा पर फैलने वाले संक्रमण (एरिसिपेलस) जैसी लगती है।
Inflammation.roman: Kaan mein aisi sujan hai jo tvcha par failne wale sankraman (erisipilas) jaisi lagti hai.

Inflammation.en: The Eustachian tube (the tube connecting the ear to the back of the throat) is inflamed.
Inflammation.hi: कान की अंदरूनी नली (यूस्टेशियन ट्यूब) में सूजन है।
Inflammation.roman: Kaan ki andruini nali (yusteshiyan tube) mein sujan hai.

Inflammation.en: The inside of the ear is inflamed.
The edge or rim of the outer ear is inflamed.
Inflammation.hi: कान के किनारे पर सूजन है।
Inflammation.roman: Kaan ke kinare par sujan hai.

Inflammation.en: There is inflammation of the middle ear.
Inflammation.hi: कान के बीच वाले हिस्से में सूजन है (मध्य कर्ण में)।
Inflammation.roman: Kaan ke beech wale hisse mein sujan hai (madhya karn mein).

Inflammation.path: Ear, inflammation, petrous portion temporal bone
Inflammation.en: There is inflammation of the hard bone at the base of the skull behind the ear.
Inflammation.hi: कान की हड्डी (कनपटी की हड्डी का पथरीला हिस्सा) में सूजन है।
Inflammation.roman: Kaan ki haddi mein sujan hai.

Inflammation.en: There is inflammation inside the ear that is producing pus.
Inflammation.hi: कान में पस (मवाद) पड़ने वाली सूजन है।
Inflammation.roman: Kaan mein pas padne wali sujan hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Ear, itching, about the ear, evening
Linked to time of day.en: The area around the outside of the ear is itchy in the evening.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम के समय कान के आसपास खुजली होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ke samay kaan ke aaspass khujli hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The ear is itchy in the afternoon.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर बाद कान में खुजली होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar baad kaan mein khujli hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Ear, itching, behind ear, evening in bed
Linked to time of day.en: The skin behind the ear is itchy in the evening when in bed.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को बिस्तर में जाने पर कान के पीछे खुजली होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko bistar mein jane par kaan ke peeche khujli hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The skin behind the ear is itchy at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को कान के पीछे खुजली होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko kaan ke peeche khujli hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The skin behind the ear is itchy at noon.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर के समय कान के पीछे खुजली होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar ke samay kaan ke peeche khujli hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The ear is itchy in the evening.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम के समय कान में खुजली होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ke samay kan mein khujli hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The ear is itchy at 9 p.m. in the evening.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को रात नौ बजे के आसपास कान में खुजली होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko rat nau baje ke aaspass kan mein khujli hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: There is an itching feeling in the ear lobe at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात के समय कान की लौ में खुजली होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Rat ke samay kan ki lau mein khujli hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: There is an itching feeling in the ear in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह के समय कान में खुजली होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah ke samay kan mein khujli hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: There is an itching feeling in the ear at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को कान में खुजली होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko kaan mein khujli hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: There is an itching feeling in the ear shortly after getting up.
Linked to time of day.hi: उठने के थोड़ी देर बाद कान में खुजली होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Uthne ke thodi der baad kaan mein khujli hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: There is an itching feeling in the ear during sleep.
Linked to time of day.hi: नींद के दौरान कान में खुजली होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Neend ke dauran kaan mein khujli hoti hai.

Comes with other symptoms.en: The ear itchiness alternates with itchiness around the anus.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: कभी कान में खुजली होती है तो कभी गुदा (मलद्वार) में।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Kabhi kaan mein khujli hoti hai to kabhi guda mein.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Ear, itching, extending over whole body
Comes with other symptoms.en: The itching starts in the ear and spreads over the whole body.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: कान की खुजली फैलकर पूरे शरीर में होने लगती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Kan ki khujli failkar pure sharir mein hone lagti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.en: The bump of cartilage below the ear opening (the antitragus) is itchy.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: कान के नीचे बाहरी उभरे हिस्से (एंटीट्रैगस) में खुजली होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Kaan ke neeche bahari ubhre hisse mein khujli hoti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.en: The skin behind the ear is itchy.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: कान के पीछे खुजली होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Kaan ke peeche khujli hoti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Ear, itching, behind ear, burning, followed by
Sensation / feel of the area.en: The skin behind the ear is itchy, followed by a burning sensation after scratching.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: कान के पीछे खुजली होती है और बाद में जलन होने लगती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Kaan ke peeche khujli hoti hai aur baad mein jalan hone lagti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.en: The skin just below the ear is itchy.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: कान के नीचे की तरफ खुजली होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Kaan ke neeche ki taraf khujli hoti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is an urge to poke a finger into the ear to relieve the itch.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: कान में उँगली घुसाकर खुजलाने की इच्छा होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Kaan mein ungli ghusakar khujlane ki ichchha hoti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.en: The ear itch has a burning quality.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: कान में जलन के साथ खुजली होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Kaan mein jalan ke saath khujli hoti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.en: The ear itch has a burning quality that comes on after scratching.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: खुजलाने के बाद कान में जलन होने लगती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Khujlane ke baad kaan mein jalan hone lagti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.en: The bowl-shaped outer part of the ear (the concha) is itchy.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: कान के बाहरी कटोरेनुमा हिस्से में खुजली होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Kan ke bahari katore numa hisse mein khujli hoti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.en: The ear itching has a biting or corrosive quality.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: कान में बहुत तेज़ और चुभने वाली खुजली होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Kan mein bahut tez aur chubhne wali khujli hoti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.en: The outer part of the ear (the visible ear) is itchy.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: कान के बाहरी हिस्से में खुजली होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Kan ke bahari hisse mein khujli hoti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.en: The ear feels itchy in the way that a part of the body feels when it has been frostbitten or frozen.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: कान में ऐसी खुजली होती है जैसे कान ठंड से सुन्न हो गया हो।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Kan mein aisi khujli hoti hai jaise kan thandi se sunn ho gaya ho.

Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is an itching feeling inside the ear.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: कान में खुजली होना।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Kan mein khujli hona.

Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is an itching feeling in front of the ear.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: कान के आगे की तरफ खुजली होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Kan ke aage ki taraf khujli hoti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is an itching feeling in the left ear.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: बाएँ कान में खुजली होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Baye kan mein khujli hoti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is an itching feeling in the ear lobe.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: कान की लौ (नीचे वाले हिस्से) में खुजली होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Kan ki lau (niche wale hisse) mein khujli hoti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is an itching feeling in the right ear.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: दाएँ कान में खुजली होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Daaye kaan mein khujli hoti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is an itching feeling in the ear that makes you want to rub it.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: कान को रगड़ने पर खुजली होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Kaan ko ragadne par khujli hoti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is an itching feeling in the ear that makes you want to scratch it.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: कान खुजलाने पर खुजली होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Kaan khujlane par khujli hoti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Ear, itching, scratching, must scratch until it bleeds
Sensation / feel of the area.en: The itching in the ear is so intense you scratch it until it bleeds.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: कान में इतनी तेज़ खुजली होती है कि खून निकलने तक खुजलाते रहना पड़ता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Kaan mein itni tez khujli hoti hai ki khoon nikalne tak khujlate rahna padta hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is a sharp, stitching itching feeling in the ear.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: कान में चुभन जैसी खुजली होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Kaan mein chubhan jaisi khujli hoti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.en: The itching feeling in the ear forces you to keep swallowing.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: बार-बार निगलने की इच्छा होती है क्योंकि कान में खुजली होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Baar-baar nigalne ki ichha hoti hai kyonki kaan mein khujli hoti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is an itching feeling on the small bump (tragus) at the front opening of the ear.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: कान के ट्रेगस (कान के छेद के सामने की छोटी उभरी हड्डी) में खुजली होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Kaan ke tragus mein khujli hoti hai.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Ear, itching, behind ear, scratching amel.
Triggered by specific actions.en: The itching behind the ear gets better when scratched.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: कान के पीछे खुजलाने से खुजली कम हो जाती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Kaan ke peeche khujlane se khujli kam ho jati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Ear, itching, boring with finger, amel.
Triggered by specific actions.en: The itching in the ear gets better when a finger is poked into the ear canal.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: कान में उँगली घुसाकर खुजलाने से खुजली कम हो जाती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Kaan mein ungli ghusakar khujlane se khujli kam ho jati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Ear, itching, boring with finger, does not amel.
Triggered by specific actions.en: The itching in the ear does NOT get better when a finger is poked into the ear canal.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: कान में उँगली घुसाकर खुजलाने से भी खुजली कम नहीं होती।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Kaan mein ungli ghusakar khujlane se bhi khujli kam nahi hoti.

Triggered by specific actions.en: The ear becomes itchy during a cough.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: खाँसने पर कान में खुजली होती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Khansne par kan mein khujli hoti hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: The ear is itchy in the evening while walking.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: शाम को चलते-फिरते समय कान में खुजली होती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Shaam ko chalte-phirte samay kan mein khujli hoti hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: There is an itching feeling in the ear when moving the jaw.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: जबड़ा हिलाने पर कान में खुजली होती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Jabda hilane par kaan mein khujli hoti hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: There is an itching feeling in the ear after riding.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: सवारी करने के बाद कान में खुजली होती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Sawari karne ke baad kaan mein khujli hoti hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: The itching feeling in the ear gets worse when you rub it.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: कान रगड़ने से खुजली और बढ़ जाती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Kaan ragadne se khujli aur badh jati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: The itching feeling in the ear gets better when you rub it.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: कान रगड़ने से खुजली कम हो जाती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Kaan ragadne se khujli kam ho jati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Ear, itching, rubbing, does not amel.
Triggered by specific actions.en: Rubbing the ear does not relieve the itching.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: कान रगड़ने से भी खुजली कम नहीं होती।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Kaan ragadne se bhi khujli kam nahi hoti.

Triggered by specific actions.en: The itching feeling in the ear gets better when you scratch it.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: कान खुजलाने से आराम मिलता है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Kaan khujlane se aaram milta hai.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Ear, itching, scratching, does not amel.
Triggered by specific actions.en: Scratching the ear does not relieve the itching.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: कान खुजलाने से भी खुजली कम नहीं होती।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Kaan khujlane se bhi khujli kam nahi hoti.

Triggered by specific actions.en: There is an itching feeling in the ear when swallowing.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: निगलने पर कान में खुजली होती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Nigalne par kaan mein khujli hoti hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: The itching feeling in the ear gets better when you touch it.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: कान को छूने से खुजली कम हो जाती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Kaan ko chhune se khujli kam ho jati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: There is an itching feeling in the ear while walking.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: चलते समय कान में खुजली होती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: chalte samay kaan mein khujli hoti hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: There is an itching feeling in the ear while yawning.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: जम्हाई (उबासी) लेते समय कान में खुजली होती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: jamhai lete samay kaan mein khujli hoti hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Ear, itching, burning, warm room
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: The ear itch has a burning quality that gets worse in a warm room.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: गर्म कमरे में जाने पर कान में जलन के साथ खुजली बढ़ जाती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Garam kamre mein jane par kaan mein jalan ke saath khujli badh jati hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Ear, itching, warm room
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: There is an itching feeling in the ear in a warm room.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: गर्म कमरे में जाने पर कान में खुजली होती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: garm kamre mein jane par kaan mein khujli hoti hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Ear, itching, warm room, entering from cold air
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: There is an itching feeling in the ear when coming into a warm room from cold air.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: ठंडी हवा से गर्म कमरे में जाने पर कान में खुजली होती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: thandi hawa se garm kamre mein jane par kaan mein khujli hoti hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: The ear becomes itchy while eating.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: खाना खाते समय कान में खुजली होती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Khana khate samay kan mein khujli hoti hai.

Linked to a specific organ.en: The Eustachian tubes (tubes connecting the ears to the back of the throat) are itchy.
Linked to a specific organ.hi: कान की अंदरूनी नली (यूस्टेशियन ट्यूब) में खुजली होती है।
Linked to a specific organ.roman: Kan ki andruini nali (Eustachian tube) mein khujli hoti hai.

Linked to a specific organ.path: Ear, itching, eustachian tubes, compels swallowing
Linked to a specific organ.en: The Eustachian tubes are itchy, and the itching creates a strong urge to swallow.
Linked to a specific organ.hi: कान की अंदरूनी नली में खुजली होती है जिससे बार-बार निगलने की इच्छा होती है।
Linked to a specific organ.roman: Kan ki andruini nali mein khujli hoti hai jisse bar-bar nigalne ki ichchha hoti hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Ear, itching, lying
Linked to posture/position.en: There is an itching feeling in the ear when lying down.
Linked to posture/position.hi: लेटने पर कान में खुजली होती है।

Type of pain.hi: शाम को कान में खुजली के साथ काटने जैसा दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Shaam ko kan mein khujli ke saath katne jaisa dard hota hai.

Type of pain.en: I have a biting or nipping pain in my left ear.
Type of pain.hi: बाएँ कान में काटने जैसा दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Baye kan mein katne jaisa dard hota hai.

Type of pain.en: I have a pain in my ear that feels like I have been struck or hit.
Type of pain.hi: कान में चोट लगने जैसा दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Kan mein chot lagne jaisa dard hota hai.

Type of pain.en: I have a boring or drilling pain in my ear.
Type of pain.hi: कान में बेधने या कुरेदने जैसा दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Kan mein bdhne ya kurde jaisa dard hota hai.

Type of pain.en: I have a boring or drilling pain deep inside my ear.
Type of pain.hi: कान के अंदर कुरेदने जैसा दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Kan ke andar kurde jaisa dard hota hai.

Type of pain.path: Ear, pain, boring, about the ear
Type of pain.en: I have a boring or drilling pain around the outside of my ear.
Type of pain.hi: कान के आसपास कुरेदने जैसा दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Kan ke aaspass kurde jaisa dard hota hai.

Type of pain.path: Ear, pain, boring, above the ear
Type of pain.en: I have a boring or drilling pain above my ear.
Type of pain.hi: कान के ऊपर कुरेदने जैसा दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Kaan ke upar kurenedne jaisa dard hota hai.

Type of pain.en: I have a sharp, intense boring or drilling pain in my ear.
Type of pain.hi: कान में तेज़ कुरेदने जैसा दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Kaan mein tez kurenedne jaisa dard hota hai.

Type of pain.path: Ear, pain, boring, behind the ear
Type of pain.en: I have a boring or drilling pain behind my ear.
Type of pain.hi: कान के पीछे कुरेदने जैसा दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Kaan ke peeche kurenedne jaisa dard hota hai.

Type of pain.path: Ear, pain, boring, below the ear
Type of pain.en: I have a boring or drilling pain just below my ear.
Type of pain.hi: कान के नीचे कुरेदने जैसा दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Kaan ke neeche kurenedne jaisa dard hota hai.

Type of pain.path: Ear, pain, boring, in front of ear
Type of pain.en: I have a boring or drilling pain in front of my ear.
Type of pain.hi: कान के आगे (सामने की तरफ) कुरेदने जैसा दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Kaan ke aage kurenedne jaisa dard hota hai.

Type of pain.en: I have a boring, stabbing pain in my ear.
Type of pain.hi: कान में कुरेदने और चुभने जैसा दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Kan mein kurede aur chubhne jaisa dard hota hai.

Type of pain.en: I have a boring, tickling pain in my ear.
Type of pain.hi: कान में कुरेदने और गुदगुदी जैसा दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Kan mein kurede aur gudgudi jaisa dard hota hai.

Type of pain.en: I have a burning pain in my ear.
Type of pain.hi: कान में जलन होती है।
Type of pain.roman: Kan mein jalan hoti hai.

Type of pain.path: Ear, pain, burning, about the ear
Type of pain.en: I have a burning pain around the outside of my ear.
Type of pain.hi: कान के आसपास जलन होती है।
Type of pain.roman: Kan ke aaspass jalan hoti hai.

Type of pain.path: Ear, pain, burning, behind the ear
Type of pain.en: I have a burning pain behind my ear.
Type of pain.hi: कान के पीछे जलन होती है।
Type of pain.roman: Kan ke peeche jalan hoti hai.

Type of pain.en: I have a burning pain just below my ear.
Type of pain.hi: कान के नीचे जलन होती है।
Type of pain.roman: Kan ke neeche jalan hoti hai.

Type of pain.en: I have a deep burrowing or tunnelling pain in my ear.
Type of pain.hi: कान में खोदने जैसा दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Kan mein khodne jaisa dard hota hai.

Type of pain.en: A cramping pain in the ear.
Type of pain.hi: कान में ऐंठन जैसा दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Kaan mein ainthan jaise dard hota hai.

Type of pain.en: A cramping pain behind the ear.
Type of pain.hi: कान के पीछे ऐंठन जैसा दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Kaan ke peeche ainthan jaise dard hota hai.

Type of pain.en: A cramping pain in the left ear.
Type of pain.hi: बाएँ कान में ऐंठन जैसा दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Baen kaan mein ainthan jaise dard hota hai.

Type of pain.en: A cramping pain in the earlobe.
Type of pain.hi: कान की लौ (लोब) में ऐंठन जैसा दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Kaan ki lau (lobe) mein ainthan jaise dard hota hai.

Type of pain.en: A cramping pain in the right ear.
Type of pain.hi: दाएँ कान में ऐंठन जैसा दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Daen kaan mein ainthan jaise dard hota hai.

Type of pain.en: A cutting (sharp, knife-like) pain in the ear.
Type of pain.hi: कान में काटने जैसा दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Kaan mein katne jaise dard hota hai.

Type of pain.path: Ear, pain, cutting in, above the ear
Type of pain.en: A cutting (sharp, knife-like) pain just above the ear.
Type of pain.hi: कान के ऊपर काटने जैसा दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Kaan ke upar katne jaise dard hota hai.

Type of pain.path: Ear, pain, cutting in, in front
Type of pain.en: A cutting (sharp, knife-like) pain in front of the ear.
Type of pain.hi: कान के आगे वाले हिस्से में काटने जैसा दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Kaan ke aage wale hisse mein katne jaisa dard hota hai.

Type of pain.en: A cutting (sharp, knife-like) pain in the left ear.
Type of pain.hi: बाएँ कान में काटने जैसा दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Baaye kaan mein katne jaisa dard hota hai.

Type of pain.en: A digging or boring pain in the ear.
Type of pain.hi: कान में कुरेदने जैसा दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Kaan mein kuredne jaisa dard hota hai.

Type of pain.path: Ear, pain, digging, extending to left nostril
Type of pain.en: A digging or boring pain in the ear that spreads toward the left nostril.
Type of pain.hi: कान में कुरेदने जैसा दर्द होता है जो बाईं नाक तक जाता है।
Type of pain.roman: Kaan mein kuredne jaisa dard hota hai jo bayin nak tak jata hai.

Type of pain.en: A digging or boring pain in the left ear.
Type of pain.hi: बाएँ कान में कुरेदने जैसा दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Baaye kaan mein kuredne jaisa dard hota hai.

Type of pain.en: A digging or boring pain in the right ear.
Type of pain.hi: दाएँ कान में कुरेदने जैसा दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Daaye kaan mein kuredne jaisa dard hota hai.

Type of pain.en: A drawing (pulling) pain in the ear.
Type of pain.hi: कान में खिंचाव जैसा दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Kan mein khincav jaisa dard hota hai.

Type of pain.path: Ear, pain, drawing in, about the ear
Type of pain.en: A drawing (pulling) pain around the ear.
Type of pain.hi: कान के आसपास खिंचाव जैसा दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Kan ke aaspas khincav jaisa dard hota hai.

Type of pain.path: Ear, pain, drawing in, above the ear
Type of pain.en: A drawing (pulling) pain just above the ear.
Type of pain.hi: कान के ऊपर खिंचाव जैसा दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Kan ke upar khincav jaisa dard hota hai.

Type of pain.path: Ear, pain, drawing in, above the ear, extending to crown
Type of pain.en: A drawing (pulling) pain just above the ear that spreads upward to the top of the head.
Type of pain.hi: कान के ऊपर खिंचाव जैसा दर्द होता है जो सिर के ऊपर तक जाता है।
Type of pain.roman: Kan ke upar khincav jaisa dard hota hai jo sir ke upar tak jata hai.

Type of pain.path: Ear, pain, drawing in, above the ear, in an old scar
Type of pain.en: A drawing (pulling) pain just above the ear, felt in an old scar in that area.
Type of pain.hi: कान के ऊपर पुराने घाव (निशान) वाली जगह पर खिंचाव जैसा दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Kan ke upar purane ghav (nishaan) vali jagah par khincav jaisa dard hota hai.

Type of pain.path: Ear, pain, drawing in, behind the ear
Type of pain.en: A drawing (pulling) pain behind the ear.
Type of pain.hi: कान के पीछे खिंचाव जैसा दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Kan ke peeche khincav jaisa dard hota hai.

Type of pain.path: Ear, pain, drawing in, behind the ear, extending
Type of pain.en: A drawing (pulling) pain behind the ear that spreads to another area.
Type of pain.hi: कान के पीछे खिंचाव जैसा दर्द होता है जो कहीं और तक फैलता है।
Type of pain.roman: Kan ke peeche khincav jaisa dard hota hai jo kahin aur tak failta hai.

Type of pain.path: Ear, pain, drawing in, behind the ear, extending to jaw
Type of pain.en: A drawing (pulling) pain behind the ear that spreads down toward the jaw.
Type of pain.hi: कान के पीछे खिंचाव जैसा दर्द होता है जो जबड़े तक फैलता है।
Type of pain.roman: Kan ke peeche khincav jaisa dard hota hai jo jabaare tak failta hai.

Type of pain.path: Ear, pain, drawing in, behind the ear, extending, downward
Type of pain.en: A drawing (pulling) pain behind the ear that spreads downward.
Type of pain.hi: कान के पीछे खिंचाव जैसा दर्द होता है जो नीचे की तरफ फैलता है।
Type of pain.roman: Kan ke peeche khincav jaisa dard hota hai jo neeche ki taraf failta hai.

Type of pain.path: Ear, pain, drawing in, behind the ear, extending, to mastoid process
Type of pain.en: A drawing (pulling) pain behind the ear that spreads to the bony area directly behind the ear (the mastoid).
Type of pain.hi: कान के पीछे खिंचाव जैसा दर्द होता है जो कान की हड्डी (मास्टॉइड) तक फैलता है।
Type of pain.roman: Kan ke peeche khincav jaisa dard hota hai jo kan ki haddi (mastoid) tak failta hai.

Type of pain.en: A drawing (pulling) pain in the ear that feels as if it is pulling downward.
Type of pain.hi: कान में नीचे की तरफ खिंचाव जैसा दर्द महसूस होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Kan mein neeche ki taraf khincav jaisa dard mehsus hota hai.

Type of pain.en: A drawing (pulling) pain in the ear that spreads to another area.
Type of pain.hi: कान में खिंचाव जैसा दर्द होता है जो दूसरी जगह फैलता है।
Type of pain.roman: Kaan mein khinchaav jaisa dard hota hai jo dusri jagah failta hai.

Type of pain.path: Ear, pain, drawing in, extending into eustachian tube
Type of pain.en: A drawing (pulling) pain in the ear that spreads into the Eustachian tube (the passage connecting the ear to the throat).
Type of pain.hi: कान में खिंचाव जैसा दर्द होता है जो कान की अंदरूनी नली (यूस्टेशियन ट्यूब) तक फैलता है।
Type of pain.roman: Kaan mein khinchaav jaisa dard hota hai jo kaan ki andruuni nali (Eustachian tube) tak failta hai.

Type of pain.path: Ear, pain, drawing in, extending, to neck and shoulders
Type of pain.en: A drawing (pulling) pain in the ear that spreads to the neck and shoulders.
Type of pain.hi: कान में खिंचाव जैसा दर्द होता है जो गर्दन और कंधों तक फैलता है।
Type of pain.roman: Kaan mein khinchaav jaisa dard hota hai jo gardan aur kandhon tak failta hai.

Type of pain.path: Ear, pain, drawing in, extending, to the teeth
Type of pain.en: A drawing (pulling) pain in the ear that spreads to the teeth.
Type of pain.hi: कान में खिंचाव जैसा दर्द होता है जो दांतों तक फैलता है।
Type of pain.roman: Kaan mein khinchaav jaisa dard hota hai jo danton tak failta hai.

Type of pain.path: Ear, pain, drawing in, in front
Type of pain.en: A drawing (pulling) pain in front of the ear.
Type of pain.hi: कान के आगे की तरफ खिंचाव जैसा दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Kaan ke aage ki taraf khinchaav jaisa dard hota hai.

Type of pain.en: A drawing (pulling) pain in the left ear.
Type of pain.hi: बाएँ कान में खिंचाव जैसा दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Baen kaan mein khinchaav jaisa dard hota hai.

Type of pain.en: A drawing (pulling) pain in the earlobe.
Type of pain.hi: कान की लौ (नीचे का मुलायम हिस्सा) में खिंचाव जैसा दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Kaan ki lau (neeche ka mulayam hissa) mein khinchaav jaisa dard hota hai.

Type of pain.path: Ear, pain, drawing in, lobule, under
Type of pain.en: A drawing (pulling) pain felt just under the earlobe.
Type of pain.hi: कान की लौ के नीचे खिंचाव जैसा दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Kaan ki lau ke neeche khinchaav jaisa dard hota hai.

Type of pain.en: A drawing (pulling) pain in the ear that feels as if it is pulling outward.
Type of pain.hi: कान में बाहर की तरफ खिंचाव जैसा दर्द महसूस होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Kaan mein bahar ki taraf khinchaav jaisa dard mehsus hota hai.

Type of pain.en: A drawing (pulling) pain in the ear that comes and goes in sudden waves or attacks.
Type of pain.hi: कान में खिंचाव जैसा दर्द अचानक तेज़ दौरों में आता है।
Type of pain.roman: Kaan mein khinchaav jaisa dard achanak tez daure mein aata hai.

Type of pain.en: A drawing (pulling) pain in the right ear.
Type of pain.hi: दाएँ कान में खिंचाव जैसा दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Daen kaan mein khinchaav jaisa dard hota hai.

Type of pain.en: Ear pain that spreads or travels to another part of the body.
Type of pain.hi: कान में दर्द होता है जो कहीं और फैलता है।
Type of pain.roman: Kaan mein dard hota hai jo kahin aur failta hai.

Type of pain.en: Ear pain that spreads down into the arm.
Type of pain.hi: कान में दर्द होता है जो बाँह तक फैलता है।
Type of pain.roman: Kaan mein dard hota hai jo banh tak failta hai.

Type of pain.en: Ear pain that spreads to the chest.
Type of pain.hi: कान में दर्द होता है जो छाती तक फैलता है।
Type of pain.roman: Kaan mein dard hota hai jo chhati tak failta hai.

Type of pain.en: Ear pain that spreads to the chin.
Type of pain.hi: कान में दर्द होता है जो ठुड्डी तक फैलता है।
Type of pain.roman: Kaan mein dard hota hai jo thuddi tak failta hai.

Type of pain.en: Ear pain that spreads downward.
Type of pain.hi: कान में दर्द होता है जो नीचे की तरफ फैलता है।
Type of pain.roman: Kaan mein dard hota hai jo neeche ki taraf failta hai.

Type of pain.en: Ear pain that spreads into the Eustachian tube (the passage connecting the ear to the throat).
Type of pain.hi: कान में दर्द होता है जो कान की अंदरूनी नली (यूस्टेशियन ट्यूब) तक फैलता है।
Type of pain.roman: Kaan mein dard hota hai jo kaan ki andrunee nali (Eustachian tube) tak failta hai.

Type of pain.en: Ear pain that spreads to the eye.
Type of pain.hi: कान में दर्द होता है जो आँख तक फैलता है।
Type of pain.roman: Kaan mein dard hota hai jo aankh tak failta hai.

Type of pain.en: Ear pain that spreads to the left eye.
Type of pain.hi: कान में दर्द होता है जो बाईं आँख तक फैलता है।
Type of pain.roman: Kaan mein dard hota hai jo bayin aankh tak failta hai.

Type of pain.en: Ear pain that spreads to the face.
Type of pain.hi: कान में दर्द होता है जो चेहरे तक फैलता है।
Type of pain.roman: Kaan mein dard hota hai jo chehre tak failta hai.

Type of pain.en: Ear pain that spreads all the way to the fingertips.
Type of pain.hi: कान में दर्द होता है जो उंगलियों के सिरों तक फैलता है।
Type of pain.roman: Kaan mein dard hota hai jo ungliyun ke sirun tak failta hai.

Type of pain.en: Ear pain that spreads to the forehead.
Type of pain.hi: कान में दर्द होता है जो माथे तक फैलता है।
Type of pain.roman: Kaan mein dard hota hai jo mathe tak failta hai.

Type of pain.en: Ear pain that spreads into the head.
Type of pain.hi: कान में दर्द होता है जो सिर तक फैलता है।
Type of pain.roman: Kaan mein dard hota hai jo sir tak failta hai.

Type of pain.en: Ear pain that spreads inward (deeper into the ear or head).
Type of pain.hi: कान में दर्द होता है जो अंदर की तरफ फैलता है।
Type of pain.roman: Kaan mein dard hota hai jo andar ki taraf failta hai.

Type of pain.en: Ear pain that spreads to the jaw.
Type of pain.hi: कान में दर्द होता है जो जबड़े तक फैलता है।
Type of pain.roman: Kaan mein dard hota hai jo jabrje tak failta hai.

Type of pain.en: Ear pain that spreads to the lower jaw.
Type of pain.hi: कान में दर्द होता है जो निचले जबड़े तक फैलता है।
Type of pain.roman: Kaan mein dard hota hai jo nichle jabrje tak failta hai.

Type of pain.en: Ear pain that spreads to the upper jaw.
Type of pain.hi: कान में दर्द होता है जो ऊपरी जबड़े तक फैलता है।
Type of pain.roman: Kaan mein dard hota hai jo upri jabrje tak failta hai.

Type of pain.en: Ear pain that spreads down into the left arm.
Type of pain.hi: कान में दर्द होता है जो बाईं बाँह तक फैलता है।
Type of pain.roman: Kaan mein dard hota hai jo bayin banh tak failta hai.

Type of pain.path: Ear, pain, extending, left to right
Type of pain.en: Ear pain that starts on the left side and moves to the right side.
Type of pain.hi: कान में दर्द बाईं तरफ से शुरू होकर दाईं तरफ फैलता है।
Type of pain.roman: Kaan mein dard bayin taraf se shuru hokar dayin taraf failta hai.

Type of pain.en: A gnawing, nagging pain in the ear.
Type of pain.hi: कान में कुतरने जैसा दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Kaan mein kutarne jaisa dard hota hai.

Type of pain.path: Ear, pain, gnawing, behind the ear
Type of pain.en: A gnawing, nagging pain behind the ear.
Type of pain.hi: कान के पीछे कुतरने जैसा दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Kaan ke peeche kutarne jaisa dard hota hai.

Type of pain.path: Ear, pain, gnawing, left then right
Type of pain.en: A gnawing pain that starts in the left ear and then moves to the right ear.
Type of pain.hi: पहले बाएँ कान में और फिर दाएँ कान में कुतरने जैसा दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Pehle baen kaan mein aur fir daen kaan mein kutarne jaisa dard hota hai.

Type of pain.en: A gnawing, nagging pain in the right ear.
Type of pain.hi: दाएँ कान में कुतरने जैसा दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Daen kaan mein kutarne jaisa dard hota hai.

Type of pain.en: A cramping, griping pain in the ear.

Swelling & bloating.roman: Kaan ke piche sujan hai jo chamakdaar dikhti hai.

Swelling & bloating.en: Swelling below the ear.

Swelling & bloating.path: Ear, tubercle, hard behind, left ear

Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Kaan ki lau (lob) mein fadkan hoti hai jo bahar se dikhai deti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is a twitching or jerking sensation in the ear canal (the opening leading into the ear).
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: कान की नली के अंदर फड़कन होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Kaan ki nali ke andar fadkan hoti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is a twitching or jerking sensation in or around the right ear.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: दाएँ कान में फड़कन होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Daaye kaan mein phadkan hoti hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: There is a twitching or jerking sensation in the ear that is triggered by blowing the nose.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: नाक छिनकते समय कान में फड़कन होती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Naak chinkate samay kaan mein fadkan hoti hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: There is a twitching or jerking sensation in or around the ear that comes on when getting up (rising).
Triggered by specific actions.hi: उठते समय (बिस्तर से) कान में फड़कन होती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Uthte samay bistaar se kaan mein phadkan hoti hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: There is a twitching or jerking sensation in the ear that is triggered by sneezing.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: छींकने पर कान में फड़कन होती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Chhinkhne par kaan mein phadkan hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: There is a twitching or jerking sensation in or around the ear that occurs in the evening.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को कान में फड़कन होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko kaan mein fadkan hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: There is a twitching or jerking sensation in or around the ear that occurs in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह कान में फड़कन होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah kaan mein fadkan hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: There is a twitching or jerking sensation in or around the ear that occurs at 6 in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह छह बजे कान में फड़कन होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah chhah baje kaan mein fadkan hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: There is a twitching or jerking sensation in or around the ear that occurs on waking in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह नींद खुलने पर कान में फड़कन होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah neend khulne par kaan mein fadkan hoti hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: There is an ulcer or open sore on the skin around the outside of the ear.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: कान के आसपास छाले/घाव हो गए हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Kaan ke aaspaas chhaale ghav ho gaye hain.

Skin/tissue changes.path: Ear, ulceration, in front of ear
Skin/tissue changes.en: There is an ulcer or open sore in front of the ear.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: कान के आगे की तरफ छाले/घाव हो गए हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Kaan ke aage ki taraf chhaale ghav ho gaye hain.

Skin/tissue changes.path: Ear, ulceration, in front of ear, fistulous opening
Skin/tissue changes.en: There is a small tunnel-like opening (fistula) in front of the ear that forms part of an ulcer or sore.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: कान के आगे एक नासूर (फिस्टुला) जैसा छेद बन गया है जिसमें से रिसाव होता है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Kaan ke aage ek nasoor jaisa ched ban gaya hai jisme se risav hota hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: There is an ulcer or open sore inside the ear.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: कान के अंदर छाले/घाव हो गए हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Kaan ke andar chhaale ghav ho gaye hain.

Skin/tissue changes.en: There is an ulcer or open sore on or around the left ear.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: बाएँ कान में छाले/घाव हो गए हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Baaye kaan mein chhaale ghav ho gaye hain.

Skin/tissue changes.path: Ear, ulceration, lobe, in hole for earrings
Skin/tissue changes.en: There is an ulcer or open sore in the piercing hole of the earlobe.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: कान की लौ (लोब) में बाली के छेद पर घाव हो गया है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Kaan ki lau mein bali ke ched par ghav ho gaya hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: There is an ulcer or open sore on or around the right ear.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: दाएँ कान में छाले/घाव हो गए हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Daaye kaan mein chhaale ghav ho gaye hain.

Skin/tissue changes.en: There is an ulcer or open sore on the eardrum.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: कान के पर्दे पर घाव (छाला या जख्म) है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Kaan ke parde par ghav hai.

Comes with other symptoms.en: There is an ulcer or sore around the ear, and swallowing is painful.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: निगलते समय कान में घाव होने की वजह से दर्द होता है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Nigalte samay kaan mein ghav hone ki wajah se dard hota hai.

Skin/tissue changes.path: Ear, wart-like growth, behind ear, inflamed and ulcerated
Skin/tissue changes.en: There is a wart-like growth behind the ear that is inflamed and has an open sore on it.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: कान के पीछे मस्से जैसी गांठ है जो सूजी हुई और जख्मी हो गई है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Kaan ke peeche masse jaisi gaanth hai jo suji hui aur jakmi ho gyi hai.

Skin/tissue changes.path: Ear, wart-like growth, on the ears
Skin/tissue changes.en: There is a wart-like growth on the ear.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: कान के ऊपर मस्से जैसी गांठ है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Kaan ke upar masse jaisi gaanth hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is a sensation as if there is water in the ear.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: कान में पानी भरा होने जैसा एहसास होता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Kaan mein pani bhara hone jaisa ehsas hota hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Ear, water, sensation of, cold, running out of ears
Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is a sensation as if cold water is running out of the ear.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: कान से ठंडा पानी बह रहा हो ऐसा लगता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Kaan se thanda pani bah raha ho aisa lagta hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Ear, water, sensation of, in ear
Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is a sensation as if there is water inside the ear.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: कान के अंदर पानी होने जैसा महसूस होता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Kaan ke andar pani hone jaisa mehsus hota hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Ear, water, sensation of, left ear
Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is a sensation as if there is water in the left ear.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: बाएँ कान में पानी होने जैसा महसूस होता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Baaye kaan mein pani hone jaisa mehsus hota hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Ear, water, sensation of, passing out of
Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is a sensation as if water is flowing out of the ear.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: कान से पानी बाहर निकल रहा हो ऐसा लगता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Kaan se pani bahar nikal raha ho aisa lagta hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Ear, water, sensation of, rushing into ears
Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is a sensation as if water is rushing into the ears.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: कान में पानी तेजी से अंदर घुस रहा हो ऐसा लगता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Kaan mein pani tezi se andar gus raha ho aisa lagta hai.

Temperature sensation.en: There is a sensation as if hot water is in the ear.
Temperature sensation.hi: कान में गर्म पानी होने जैसा एहसास होता है।
Temperature sensation.roman: Kaan mein garam pani hone jaisa ehsaas hota hai.

Temperature sensation.path: Ear, water, sensation of, hot, in left ear
Temperature sensation.en: There is a sensation as if hot water is in the left ear.
Temperature sensation.hi: बाएँ कान में गर्म पानी भरा हो ऐसा लगता है।
Temperature sensation.roman: Baaye kaan mein garam pani bhara ho aisa lagta hai.

Temperature sensation.path: Ear, water, sensation of, hot, running out of right ear
Temperature sensation.en: There is a sensation as if hot water is running out of the right ear.
Temperature sensation.hi: दाएँ कान से गर्म पानी बाहर बह रहा हो ऐसा लगता है।
Temperature sensation.roman: Daaye kaan se garam pani bahar bah raha ho aisa lagta hai.

Temperature sensation.path: Ear, water, sensation of, warm, in
Temperature sensation.en: There is a sensation as if warm water is inside the ear.
Temperature sensation.hi: कान के अंदर गुनगुना पानी होने जैसा एहसास होता है।
Temperature sensation.roman: Kaan ke andar gunguna pani hone jaisa ehsaas hota hai.

Discharge.en: The earwax is black in color.
Discharge.hi: कान का मैल काले रंग का है।
Discharge.roman: Kaan ka mail kale rang ka hai.

Discharge.en: The earwax is brown in color.
Discharge.hi: कान का मैल भूरे रंग का है।
Discharge.roman: Kaan ka mail bhure rang ka hai.

Discharge.path: Ear, wax, brown, red or dark
Discharge.en: The earwax is brown, red, or dark in color.
Discharge.hi: कान का मैल भूरा, लाल या गहरे रंग का है।
Discharge.roman: Kaan ka mail bhura, laal ya gahre rang ka hai.

Discharge.en: The earwax is dry.
Discharge.hi: कान का मैल सूखा हुआ है।
Discharge.roman: Kaan ka mail sukha hua hai.

Discharge.path: Ear, wax, dry, peeling off in scales
Discharge.en: The earwax is dry and peels off in flakes or scales.
Discharge.hi: कान का मैल सूखकर पपड़ी की तरह उखड़ रहा है।
Discharge.roman: Kaan ka mail sukhkar papdi ki tarah ukhad raha hai.

Discharge.en: The earwax has become hard and solid.
Discharge.hi: कान का मैल सख्त हो गया है।
Discharge.roman: Kaan ka mail sakt ho gaya hai.

Discharge.en: There is more earwax than usual — it is being produced in greater amounts.
Discharge.hi: कान में मैल सामान्य से ज्यादा बन रहा है।
Discharge.roman: Kaan mein mail samanya se zyada ban raha hai.

Discharge.en: The earwax is pale in color.
Discharge.hi: कान का मैल हल्के (फीके) रंग का है।
Discharge.roman: Kaan ka mail halke rang ka hai.

Discharge.en: The earwax looks like pus or has a pus-like quality.
Discharge.hi: कान का मैल पीप जैसा (मवादयुक्त) है।
Discharge.roman: Kaan ka mail pip jaisa hai.

Discharge.en: The earwax is red in color.
Discharge.hi: कान का मैल लाल रंग का है।
Discharge.roman: Kaan ka mail laal rang ka hai.

Discharge.en: The earwax has a reddish tinge.
Discharge.hi: कान का मैल लालिमा लिए हुए है।
Discharge.roman: Kaan ka mail lalima liye hue hai.

Discharge.en: The earwax has an unusual smell, like rotten paper.
Discharge.hi: कान का मैल सड़े हुए कागज जैसा लगता है।
Discharge.roman: Kaan ka mail sade hue kagaz jaisa lagta hai.

Discharge.en: The earwax is soft in texture.
Discharge.hi: कान का मैल नरम और मुलायम है।
Discharge.roman: Kaan ka mail norm aur mulayam hai.

Discharge.en: The earwax is thick in consistency.
Discharge.hi: कान का मैल गाढ़ा है।
Discharge.roman: Kaan ka mail gadha hai.

Discharge.en: The earwax is thin or runny in consistency.
Discharge.hi: कान का मैल पतला है।
Discharge.roman: Kaan ka mail patla hai.

Discharge.en: There is no earwax present — the ear canal seems completely dry and lacking wax.
Discharge.hi: कान में बिल्कुल मैल नहीं बनता।
Discharge.roman: Kaan mein bilkul mail nahi banta.

Discharge.en: The earwax is whitish in color.
Discharge.hi: कान का मैल सफेदी लिए हुए है।
Discharge.roman: Kaan ka mail safedi lie hue hai.

Discharge.en: The earwax is whitish and has a mushy or porridge-like texture.
Discharge.hi: कान का मैल सफेद और लेई जैसा गाढ़ा है।
Discharge.roman: Kaan ka mail safed aur lei jaisa gadha hai.

Discharge.en: The earwax is yellow in color.
Discharge.hi: कान का मैल पीले रंग का है।
Discharge.roman: Kaan ka mail pile rang ka hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: There is a soft, round, fatty lump (a wen) behind the ear.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: कान के पीछे चर्बी की गांठ (गुमड़) है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Kaan ke piche charbi ki gant (gumd) hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: There is a soft, round, fatty lump (a wen) on the earlobe.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: कान की लौ (लोब) पर चर्बी की गांठ है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Kaan ki lau (lob) par charbi ki gant hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is a sensation as if wind or air is blowing in the ear.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: कान में हवा चल रही हो ऐसा एहसास होता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Kaan mein hawa chal rahi ho aisa ehsas hota hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is a sensation as if wind or air is blowing inside the ear.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: कान के अंदर हवा होने जैसा महसूस होता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Kaan ke andar hawa hone jaisa mehsus hota hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Ear, wind, sensation of, passing into or blowing upon
Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is a sensation as if wind or air is passing into the ear or blowing upon it.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: कान में हवा अंदर आ रही हो या बाहर से लग रही हो ऐसा लगता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Kaan mein hawa andar aa rahi ho ya bahar se lag rahi ho aisa lagta hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Ear, wind, sensation of, passing out of ears
Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is a sensation as if wind or air is passing out of the ear.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: कान से हवा बाहर निकल रही हो ऐसा लगता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Kaan se hawa bahar nikal rahi ho aisa lagta hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Ear, wind, sensation of, passing out of ears, putting finger in, amel.
Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is a sensation as if wind or air is passing out of the ear, and putting a finger in the ear makes it feel better.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: कान में उँगली डालने से हवा निकलने का एहसास कम हो जाता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Kaan mein ungli dalne se hawa nikalne ka ehsas kam ho jata hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Ear, wind, sensation of, puffing out or ears
Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is a sensation as if wind or air is puffing or blowing out of the ear.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: कान से हवा बाहर फूंक मारने जैसी निकल रही हो ऐसा लगता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Kaan se hawa bahar phunk marne jaisi nikal rahi ho aisa lagta hai.

Temperature sensation.path: Ear, wind, sensation of, cold, as if blowing against meatus of right ear
Temperature sensation.en: There is a sensation as if cold wind is blowing against the opening of the right ear canal.
Temperature sensation.hi: दाएँ कान की नली पर ठंडी हवा लग रही हो ऐसा लगता है।
Temperature sensation.roman: Daaye kaan ki nali par thandi hawa lag rahi ho aisa lagta hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Ear, wind, sensitive to
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: The ear is very sensitive to wind or drafts of air.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: कान में हवा लगने से तकलीफ होती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Kaan mein hawa lagne se taklif hoti hai.
